messages:
Maya: Pushing v2.3.0 to staging. immediate p99 jump on /api/generate from ~220ms -> ~510ms.
Owen: did deploy-bot pause the canary? :eyes:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused automatically due to latency SLO breach on route /api/generate (staging). Canary stopped at 10%.
Maya: repro: ./tools/run_workload --model redwood-v2.3.0 --seq 512 --qps 40 --batch-heuristic adaptive
Sana: profiler on a single pod: kernels flip between `cuda_gemm_fp16` and `int8_gemv_fast` mid-request. allocator churn + kvcache prefetch backlog. flamegraph shows big memcpy and kernel_select spikes.
Liam: paste kernel trace?
Sana: [trace snippet]
[2026-03-18T12:07:03Z] select_kernel(model=redwood-v2.3.0, seq=512) -> int8_gemv_fast
[2026-03-18T12:07:03Z] kvcache: prefetch_enqueue req=348 backlog=7
[2026-03-18T12:07:03Z] alloc: fallback to spare_pool (size=256MB)
[2026-03-18T12:07:03Z] select_kernel -> cuda_gemm_fp16 (re-route because qconfig mismatch)
[2026-03-18T12:07:03Z] kvcache: prefetch_dequeue processed=0 hold=1
Owen: qconfig mismatch + tokenizer change maybe. new checkpoint added a tokenizer normalizer that trims whitespace -> avg seq shorter and selector heuristics flip.
Maya: synthetic test: trimmed tokens choose int8 70% vs original fp16 95%.
Liam: bisect: suspect commits 9b4e8d0 (selector threshold tweak) and c4f8a21 (tokenizer normalizer).
Owen: bisect results:
- Revert 9b4e8d0 -> p99 back to ~230ms
- Revert c4f8a21 -> p99 still high
Sana: CI perf job 4567 failed with +150ms p99. https://ci.redwood/abc/perf/4567
ci-bot: Perf job 4567: failed on staging-e2e perf with v2.3.0; regression between 9b4e8d0..c4f8a21
Maya: hypothesis: selector lowered threshold to prefer int8 when avg seq < 80. Tokenizer normalizer nudged avg seq to ~74 -> oscillation. int8 path has faster kernel but incompatible kvcache layout -> prefetch backlog and evictions -> allocator fallback -> latency spikes.
Liam: added log shows prefetch queue +60% during spikes. heuristic config changed in 9b4e8d0:
kernel_selector:
  int8_seq_threshold: 80  # was 64
  prefer_int8_for_short_seqs: true
Owen: mitigation: revert threshold to 64 (temporary), add GA perf test in CI for onboarding, add kvcache prefetch cap.
Sana: hotfix: cap prefetch inflight per-pod to 16, cooldown on allocator fallback, add "kernel_swaps_per_request" metric. preparing PR.
Maya: immediate plan:
1) revert 9b4e8d0 in staging (Owen)
2) push prefetch cap + metrics (Sana)
3) add CI perf gate that runs synthetic workload with new checkpoints and fails if p99 delta > 20% (Liam)
Owen: rolling back selector change now.
deploy-bot: Revert PR merged: r-5478. Canary resumed at 10%.
Maya: post-revert staging p99 -> 240ms. Canary progressing. :tada:
Liam: follow-ups: make tokenizer onboarding include sample length histogram to warn when avg-seq crosses selector thresholds; kernel selector should consult kvcache health before switching.
Sana: opening hotfix PR with metrics + unit tests for prefetch cap.
Maya: filing a short postmortem after stabilize. CC: @prod @platform
